items.title: Dangerous Escalation: US–Israel Strikes on Iran and Iran’s Retaliation Raise Fears of Wider War
items.excerpt: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan warns that the escalating confrontation between the United States, Israel, and Iran risks triggering a wider regional conflict with global consequences.
items.author: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan

heroImage.caption: Escalating tensions in the Middle East following US–Israel strikes and Iran’s retaliation.
